text:
june: spinning up a follow-up quant canary focused on funcall exactness. mirror + 0.5% live, 16h. objective: ensure int8 parity on exact JSON outputs (golden-check stream).

rahul: Whats the golden stream size and failure threshold?

june: golden_stream=2k/h, threshold=0.25% mismatches at p95. repair_mode=none for golden checks (no post-repair allowed). Postprocess repairs still run for general mirror, but golden items are fail-fast.

ben: telemetry hooks added. emitting: parse_ok, funcall_exact, rm_before, rm_after, repair_attempted, repair_succeeded.

ci-bot: canary registered: id=canary-7763331111-b. shards=4, kernel=int8, kv_comp=off on shard-2 for A/B.

sara: quick note  last time we saw small ordering diffs tolerated by RM. golden check will catch those; may need to relax for non-deterministic ordering in arrays if safe.

rahul: first 2h snapshot: baseline_parse=99.14% mirror_parse=98.88% (delta -0.26%). golden_mismatch_rate=0.04% (well below threshold). repairs_attempted=38 repairs_failed=2. rm_delta_median=-0.005.

ben: sampled failures looked like trailing comma insertion on some arrays for a tiny subset. examples uploaded to governance bucket.

june: good. maintain kv_comp=off while we validate; rahul please add a small unit test simulating compressed-kv token chunking to runtime repo.

raj: (typo: rahul) test in progress. will tag bench PR link when ready.

ci-bot: mid-canary (8h): golden_mismatch_rate=0.02%. overall repair_failure_rate=1.8%. rm_delta_median=-0.003. recommended: proceed to 1% live if golden remains <0.05% for another 12h.

june: agreed. docs: record canary_id and repair_mode in all logs. If golden fails, abort live immediately and revert to mirror-only.

ben: scheduling a short post-run with kernel and tokenizer teams to discuss permanent kv_comp policy for structured endpoints.

ci-bot: final snapshot (16h): golden_mismatch_rate=0.01%. mirror_parse_delta=-0.15%. rm_delta_median=-0.002. canary closed: status=passed; id=canary-7763331111-b.

june: nice work. next steps: merge the unit test PR and add a regression alert for golden_mismatch_rate > 0.1% in prod.

rahul: will open PR and link here.

sara: adding follow-up eval: ensemble check (int8 vs fp16 majority) for any remaining marginal cases.

june: thanks team, closing thread.
